objective: Evaluate whether PGAI can help a fictional patient request a routine primary-care appointment.
intended_outcome: Obtain an offered appointment time or a clear, actionable next step.
steering_points: State that the patient wants a routine primary-care appointment.
If asked for the reason, explain that this is a routine non-urgent appointment and do not introduce symptoms or request medical advice.
Prefer a weekday morning when PGAI asks about availability.
Before accepting an appointment, confirm the date, time, location, and appointment type.
safe_stopping_conditions: The intended outcome or an actionable alternative is clearly stated.
PGAI requests real patient information or information outside the fictional profile.
The conversation moves into medical advice or emergency handling.
The controlled three-minute limit is approaching.
